title: When I completely embarrassed myself – C1 English Listening Test

seo.title: When I completely embarrassed myself – C1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Listen to three embarrassing stories in this C1 English Listening Test and boost your listening skills with instant feedback and transcript!

parts:
C1 English Listening Test

Listen to three people telling their most embarrassing anecdotes. For questions 1–8, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
See the full list of C1 listening tests
Questions

choices.html: Fiona and her boyfriend went out because they needed milk, tea, and bread.
They tried to find a parking spot for a long time.
Fiona's boyfriend drove around the shop building.
Fiona got into a moving car.
The driver knew Fiona but didn't recognise her.
Fiona wanted to prank her boyfriend.
Because the driver was looking back.
Because he accelerated in panic.
Because he didn't see the car in front had stopped.
Amanda is the manager of a big team.
John wanted to give the shirt to someone.
John couldn't attend due to health issues.
Amanda sent John an XL shirt.
She misspelled a word, which completely changed her message.
John had an emergency.

questions.prompt: Why did the lady invite Connor in?

choices.html: To offer him a cup of coffee.
To lend him dry clothes.
To give him shelter.
He tripped over something and fell.
He broke a photograph of the lady's late husband.
He had an accident with the lady’s husband's remains.

questions.prompt: Judging by her first reaction, the lady found the incident funny.

choices.html: True
False
